description: Base64 encoded string in bash history -- a easy-tier linux challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Base64 encoded string in bash history"
